Defines high-impact, long-term (i.e., 2-5+ year horizon) business strategies at the corporate, business, and/or regional level. Monitors external factors during strategic development, including market forces, macro/microeconomic factors, and competitive implications. Works with and manages cross-functional project teams. Conducts rigorous, data-driven analyses to diagnose the current state and model future outcomes for business performance. Develops recommendations for senior management based on competitive market, financial, statistical, and economic trend data. Manages corporate strategy initiatives and participates in communicating the strategy to the client organization.

- Identifies research, tools, and analyses required to achieve objectives for large, complex business strategy projects.
- Structures analytical approaches and develops project strategies and tactics.
- Develops recommendations for optimizing business and financial performance.
- Manages large, cross- functional teams and communications to facilitate projects and ensure timely delivery to clients.
- Leads the development of project guidelines, contingency plans, objectives, and deliverables.
- Consults with business executives on a wide range of issues related to the strategy formulation process, including risk management and new growth opportunities.
- Provides thought leadership and contributes to expanding the knowledge base within area of expertise which includes developing new methods, techniques and criteria for developing strategy analysis and recommendations.
- Collaborates across businesses, functions, and regions to align strategy and direction with corporate and divisional approaches, systems, information and support.

Experience and Education:
- Often 4-7 years post- advanced degree experience leading projects, deals, and company financial improvement initiatives in management consulting, corporate strategy, investment banking, or market research.
- Typically 7+ years of Consulting experience, Corporate Strategy experience, or Investment Banking experience
- Experience in Corporate Strategy, Investment Banking, or Consulting required
- Advanced university degree (e.g., MBA) preferred.

Knowledge and Skills:
- Excellent analytical thinking, analysis, and problem solving skills
- Ability to communicate abstract ideas clearly and independently manage complex project objectives
- Extensive knowledge of and ability to manage statistical analysis and financial modeling.
- Advanced business acumen, technical knowledge within at multiple business units, and extensive knowledge in applications and technologies.
- Very strong verbal and written communication skills, including negotiation, presentation, and influence.
- Superior group facilitation, interviewing, and influence skills.
- Excellent project management skills, including project structuring and managing multiple work streams independently.
- Strong relationship management skills, including partnering and consulting.
- Strong leadership skills, including coaching, team- building, conflict resolution, and management.
- Ability to identify and draw on leading-edge analytical tools and techniques to develop creative approaches and new insights to client issues.
- Ability to independently draft and present client deliverables, recommendations, and communications strategies.

- Strong strategic thinking with the ability to connect market trends, customer requirements, and financial performance to business decisions.
- Advanced financial modeling, forecasting, profitability analysis, and scenario planning capabilities.
- Ability to translate complex data into executive-level recommendations and compelling business narratives.
- Learn quickly, adapt to new methods, and apply insights to practical business challenges.

- Serve as the central point of accountability for geo-expansion status, risks, trade-offs, and outcomes from working-team through executive levels.

- Prioritized multi-phased country expansion strategy and launch roadmap.
- Country-readiness scorecards, market-entry recommendations, and approved business cases.

Cloud Commit Channel Program Manager

Hybrid Cloud Strategy and Operations
Role Overview
The Cloud Commit Channel and Distribution Program Manager will lead the strategic expansion, design, launch, and scaled operation of HPE Cloud Commit across indirect routes to market. Cloud Commit is a multi-year spend commitment program through which customers receive contractual incentives, including preferential pricing, procurement efficiency, and purchasing flexibility across eligible software, infrastructure, and services in the Hybrid Cloud portfolio.
This role will design and operationalize the commercial model required for distributors and resellers.  Building on the program’s existing structure, this role will lead the effort to maintain the core program principles, extending the value proposition and execution of program into the channel.
The role will define how responsibilities, economics, data, and transactions flow across HPE, partners, and end customers in one-tier and two-tier models. This includes determining the appropriate commitment-holder and contracting model, partner eligibility, discount application, quoting and ordering processes, invoiced-spend attribution, reporting, reconciliation, governance, and issue resolution.
The successful candidate will combine strategic program leadership with hands-on execution, converting ambiguous business challenges into clear decisions, scalable processes, measurable requirements, partner-tested workflows, and launch-ready capabilities across countries and partner segments.
Key Responsibilities
- Own the strategy, roadmap, design, launch, and ongoing optimization of the Cloud Commit channel and distribution program across priority countries and partner segments.
- Define scalable one-tier and two-tier routes to market for distributors, resellers, cloud service providers, managed service providers, and other eligible channel partners.

Please note that Hewlett Packard Enterprise (HPE), its direct and indirect subsidiaries and affiliated companies, and its authorized recruitment agencies/vendors will never charge a candidate a registration fee, hiring fee, or any other fee in connection with its recruitment and hiring process. We also never request personal information such as back account details, Social Security numbers, or national IDs via social media or chat applications.

All legitimate job opportunities will come through official company channels, and candidates are responsible for verifying the credentials of any third party claiming to represent the company. Any reliance on fraudulent communication is at the individual’s own risk, and HPE disclaims legal liability for any resulting damages. If you suspect recruitment fraud, do not share personal information or make any payments and report the incident to your local authorities immediately.
